backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing poem and collection management with user profiles, notifications, and access control using mixins for authorization and blob storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implementation of admin route guards and conditional navigation link visibility for admin users.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and utilities for the Gojri poetry application.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes with warm earth tone palette.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with document title 'International Gojri Maa Boli Adab' and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with admin route guards, QueryClient provider, ThemeProvider, and route tree including protected admin routes.
Route guard component that verifies authentication and admin status, redirecting non-admin users to home with toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with header containing navigation links conditionally displayed only for authenticated admin users, plus login button and notification bell.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component handling Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/NotificationBell: Bell icon button with unread count badge that opens a popover containing the notification panel for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/NotificationPane: Displays a scrollable list of notifications with loading states, empty states, and the ability to mark individual notifications as read using a check button.
frontend/src/components/PoemCard.tsx: Renders a poem card with support for both text and image poem types, displays metadata (author, date, collections), and includes a dialog for adding the poem to multiple collections.
frontend/src/components/UserProfileSetup: Shows a modal dialog prompting authenticated users without a profile to enter their name, blocking interaction until profile setup is complete.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, initializing access control with admin token and invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality, identity state management, and configurable AuthClient options including derivation origin support.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including poems, collections, user profiles, notifications, search, and admin functions with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global styles with warm earth-tone color scheme for light and dark modes, imports Google Fonts (Crimson Text, Lora, Inter), and configures Tailwind CSS layers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminForm.tsx: Admin form page for submitting new poems (text or image) with collection assignment. Handles authentication, image upload with progress tracking, and form validation.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page for assigning admin roles to users by Principal ID. Includes authentication checks, admin authorization verification, and role assignment functionality.
frontend/src/pages/CollectionManager.tsx: Collection management page for creating collections, adding/removing poems to/from collections, and deleting collections. Provides UI for managing poem organization with dialogs and selection controls.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Main landing page displaying all poems with search functionality and collection filtering. Implements debounced search and dynamic poem display based on selected collection or search results.
frontend/src/pages/PoemDetail.tsx: Detailed poem view page showing individual poem content with download options (image or generated text image) and ability to add poem to collections. Handles both text and image poem types.
frontend/src/utils/downloadHelpers.ts: Utility functions for downloading images from URLs or Blobs and sanitizing filenames for safe file downloads.
frontend/src/utils/formatDate.ts: Utility function to convert backend Time (nanoseconds) to human-readable date string format.
frontend/src/utils/poemImageGenerator.ts: Generates a shareable PNG image of a poem on a canvas with decorative borders, gradient background, and formatted text including title, content, author, and branding.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH, typography settings, animations, and extended theme properties for the frontend UI.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking architectural decisions, known issues, and pending feature requests for implementing admin-only access control in the poetry platform.
